description: Self-driving vacuum cleaner that finds its own way round the floor and returns to a dock. Some also mop and some empty themselves at the dock.
Self-driving floor cleaner that mops with a driven pad or roller and a water tank, with no suction. A robot vacuum that also mops is under Robot vacuum cleaner.
Salt that keeps a dishwasher's built-in water softener working.
Polish, conditioner or spray to care for, colour or waterproof shoes.
Product or tablet that removes limescale from kettles, coffee machines and other appliances.
Product made to clean sex toys.
Top-loading washing machine with a low disc or cone at the bottom of the drum that moves the wash.
Washer and dryer stacked and built as one single appliance.
Washing machine with separate tubs for washing and for spin-drying. Sold mainly in Japan.
Tumble dryer that removes moisture from the air without a duct, using a condenser or heat pump.
Appliance that blows warm air into a bag or mat to dry and warm bedding. Sold mainly in Japan.
Unit fitted in a bathroom ceiling or wall to dry laundry, even if it also ventilates. Sold mainly in Japan.
Spray that removes odours from fabrics.
Spray that waterproofs or protects fabrics.
Basket, hamper or bag to hold or carry washing.
Filter made for a vacuum cleaner. Filter grades such as HEPA are a feature, not a separate product.
Water tank made for an iron or steam generator.
